test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'they'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a **pronoun** to refer to the bees mentioned in the first sentence.
 
• The second sentence uses the **they pronoun **to refer to the bees. 
 
• Thus, **they **should also be used in this blank. 
 
• This makes **option 1 **the correct answer. 

***Correct passage** - It should come as no surprise that bees know a lot about honey. They aren't only honey producers; (1) **they** are also consumers, and pretty sophisticated ones at that. Offer a sick bee (2) **different** varieties of honey, for example, and it will choose the one that (3) **best **fights off its infection. Components in honey can help bees live longer, (4) **boost **their tolerance of harsh conditions such as intense cold and increase their (5) **ability **to fight off infections and heal wounds. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **It **is a singular pronoun.
 
• **Them** is an object pronoun. We need the subject pronoun for the given blank. 
 
• **We **is the first-person personal pronoun.
